name: Turkey & Vegetable Chili with Avocado, Cheddar & Cilantro
instructions: Peel and small dice onion; transfer to a medium bowl. Peel and mince garlic; add to bowl.
Wash bell peppers, celery, and jalapeños. Seed and small dice bell peppers. Trim ends and small dice celery. Seed and mince jalapeños.
Heat a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add oil to saucepan and swirl to coat bottom. Add onion, garlic, bell pepper, celery, and jalapeño. Cook, stirring frequently, until vegetables have softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add ground turkey to the vegetables and cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3-4 minutes.
Add chili powder, cumin, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
Add tomatoes and stir to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, until chili is slightly reduced in volume, 8-10 minutes.
Wash and dry cilantro. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and chop the leaves. Stir about ½ into the chili and save the rest for garnishing.
Halve and pit avocados. Scoop out the flesh and medium dice.
Serve chili in a bowl and garnish with avocado, cheddar, cilantro, and lime. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
